# GameShell

The screen frame.

`LL.GameShell` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.GameShell>…</LL.GameShell>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.GameShell">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Renders a "Skip to content" link as the first tab stop. Under 60rem the rail becomes a drawer: opening it moves focus into the rail and makes the rest inert; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button that opened it. The drawer slides in over duration-base on ease-enter with its scrim, leaves over duration-fast on ease-exit, and once gone is hidden, so nothing off-screen takes focus. Dragging the floating Chronicle follows the pointer at once.

## Props (GameShellProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rail` | `React.ReactNode` | Usually a NavRail. |
| `top` | `React.ReactNode \| ((api: { openRail: () => void }) => React.ReactNode)` | A TopBar, or a function receiving { openRail } so the TopBar's menu button can open the rail drawer on narrow screens. |
| `folio` | `React.ReactNode` | Usually a Folio. Adds the right-hand column. |
| `hints` | `React.ReactNode` | Usually KeyHints; pinned to the stage's bottom-right on desktop, hidden under 960px. |
| `chronicle` | `React.ReactElement<ChronicleProps>` | A Chronicle (chat + game log). Placed by chatLayout. |
| `chatLayout` | `'docked' \| 'floating'` | The player's Chat layout setting (the game's ChatLayout type). docked (default): right side — own column at 1536px+, under the Folio below; floating: draggab… |
| `chronicleOpen` | `boolean` | Overrides whether the Chronicle counts as open for the layout; defaults to the Chronicle's own `open`. |
| `chroniclePosition` | `{ left: number; bottom: number } \| null` | Floating drawer position in px from the shell's bottom-left. Leave undefined to let the shell keep it. |
| `onChroniclePositionChange` | `(pos: { left: number; bottom: number }) => void` | Called while the drawer is dragged or nudged — persist it like the game's floatingDrawerPosition. |
| `height` | `number \| string` | CSS height of the shell; defaults to 100vh. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The stage — usually a Stage. |
